svg.title: Haptic evaluation and validation — editable reconstruction
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the supplied three-panel conceptual figure. Every written label, panel outline, card outline, connector, ruler tick, and chart element is a native SVG object. Thirteen original illustration cutouts are embedded as independent PNG images. Dashed connectors intentionally have no arrowheads, as in the source.

image.inkscape:label: c task board — replaceable embedded PNG
